Definition: to pull down or in pieces, break, destroy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tear down, break down, overthrow, beat down, break, break through, destroy, pluck down, pull down, throw down, ruined, destroyer, utterly; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to throw down, tear down; 1a2) to break through; 1a3) to break down, break away; 1b) (Niphal) to be torn down, be thrown down; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to overthrow, tear down; 1c2) destroyer (participle)
